DEC-007.rationale: The web UI is served by cmd/api (a local tool that should work offline). Loading Alpine from the unpkg CDN (a) adds a third-party supply-chain/interception surface between the operator and their data, (b) breaks the UI when the machine is offline or unpkg is unreachable, and (c) cannot be integrity-verified at every load without SRI. SRI-on-CDN hardens (c) but not (a)/(b). Vendoring the verified alpinejs@3.13.5 build (byte-checked against its published SRI base64) into web/vendor/alpine.min.js removes the external dependency entirely — a one-time ~44KiB asset matching the repo's self-contained ethos.
DEC-007.alternatives_rejected: SRI-integrity attribute on the CDN script tag: still requires network and leaves a live third-party dependency/availability risk. CSP with unpkg allow-list: same availability coupling. No change: leaves the supply-chain + offline-break risk open.
